rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial equivalent when a person, force, or event cannot be stopped.

example.english: Once they start shouting, they’re truly unstoppable.
example.traditional: 佢一喊起上嚟，真係阻止唔到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 haam3 hei2 soeng5 lai4 zan1 hai6 zo2 zi2 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this when the thing is already moving or happening and cannot be halted, rather than when others simply cannot prevent it.

example.english: The car can’t stop after going downhill—it’s unstoppable, so move out of the way!
example.traditional: 架車落斜之後停唔到，快啲閃開！
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 lok6 ce3 zi1 hau6 ting4 m4 dou2 faai3 di1 sim2 hoi1

rows.note: Use this mainly for a powerful force, trend, team, or advance that seems impossible to resist.

example.english: This team’s attack is truly unstoppable this year.
example.traditional: 今年呢隊波嘅攻勢真係勢不可擋。
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 ne1 deoi6 bo1 ge3 gung1 sai3 zan1 hai6 sai3 bat1 ho2 dong2
